A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
